seo_animal_title: AI Animal Rigging Online: Horse, Dog, Bird | AutoRig
seo_animal_description: AutoRig V3 rigs animals and creatures from one upload: quadruped, equine, bird, serpent, monster, multilimb. Skeleton, skin and gait clips in seconds.
animal_h1_b: for any four-legged, winged or many-legged model
animal_lead: Drop a 3D model or a picture of an animal. V3 finds its category, builds the skeleton and skin from the geometry in seconds, retargets the animation clips at once and checks the quality in the background of the viewer.
animal_hero_alt: Gallop clip of a white horse on the V3 check sheet: T-pose and five frames, each shown from the front, the side, the top and in 3D
animal_hero_cap: A real V3 check sheet: the gallop clip retargeted onto a white horse.
animal_cat_lead: Every category has its own skeleton template, fit rules, skin rules, clip library and quality checks. V3 detects the category of your model, and you can still edit the skeleton in the viewer.
animal_cat_quad_who: Dogs, cats, bears, cows, pigs, rabbits, mice, elephants, giraffes, turtles
animal_cat_quad_text: The template for animals that stand on four legs: head, neck, spine, tail and four legs, fitted to the mesh and skinned for walking.
animal_cat_quad_alt: A wolf rigged by AutoRig V3 in a viewer scene
animal_cat_equine_text: A richer template with scapula, elbow, mid-neck and leg profile joints. Gaits keep the hooves planted: walk, trot, gallop.
animal_cat_equine_alt: A brown horse rigged by AutoRig V3 in a viewer scene
animal_cat_bird_text: Wings are rigged as wings, never as arms: the wing has its own joints, and the body, neck and legs follow the bird template.
animal_cat_bird_alt: A green bird of prey with spread wings in a viewer scene
animal_cat_serpent_text: A long body without legs. The skeleton runs along the body as one chain, so the whole body can bend.
animal_cat_serpent_alt: Serpent skeleton: a chain of joints along a long body
animal_cat_monster_who: Fantasy beasts, creatures with odd proportions
animal_cat_monster_text: Creatures that fit no plain animal get their own template, fit rules and skin rules instead of being forced into a dog or a horse.
animal_cat_monster_alt: An ice monster rigged by AutoRig V3 in a viewer scene
animal_cat_multi_text: Bodies with more than four limbs. Every leg gets its own chain, so each one can move on its own.
animal_cat_multi_alt: A spider with eight legs in a viewer scene
animal_flow_lead: One upload zone takes any input. The four steps below run without you clicking through them.
animal_s1_d: A 3D model (GLB, FBX, OBJ, ZIP with textures) or a picture of the animal. A picture becomes a 3D model first, then it is rigged. A model's own textures are kept; a model without textures gets PBR textures automatically.
animal_s2_d: V3 detects the category and fits that category's skeleton template to the geometry.
animal_s3_d: The fast rig builds the skeleton and skin from the geometry in seconds, and the category's animation clips are retargeted at once. The target is a rigged, animated model within one minute from pickup.
animal_s4_d: Joint placement, skin tears, limb collisions and numeric deformation QA run in the background of the viewer while you already watch the animal move.
animal_eq_title: Horses, deer and zebras: the equine template
animal_eq_lead: A horse is not a dog with a longer neck. The equine template adds the joints that make a gait read right, and the clips are made with planted hooves.
animal_eq_j1_d: The shoulder blade moves with the front leg, so the shoulder deforms like a shoulder.
animal_eq_j2_d: A separate elbow joint in the front leg.
animal_eq_j3_d: The neck bends in the middle as well as at its base.
animal_eq_j4_d: Joints along the bends of the leg as seen from the side.
animal_eq_gait_d: A hoof that touches the ground stays on it while the body moves over it. Gaits: walk, trot, gallop.
animal_eq_sheet_alt: Gallop clip of a second horse on the V3 check sheet: T-pose and five frames, four views each
animal_eq_gif_a_alt: Animated gallop preview of the white horse rig
animal_eq_gif_b_alt: Animated gallop preview of the second horse rig
animal_eq_cap: Check sheet of a horse rig: the T-pose, then the gallop clip at 0, 20, 40, 60 and 80 %, and animated previews of two horse rigs.
animal_bird_lead: A bird's wing is not an arm. V3 rigs it with wing joints of its own, so the wing opens and folds as a wing, while the body, neck and legs follow the bird template.
animal_bird_sheet_alt: Rig check sheet of a green bird of prey: T-pose and clip frames from the front, the side and the top
animal_bird_w_alt: Skin weights of the bird: each wing and body part in its own colour, with the skeleton drawn over it
animal_bird_gif_alt: Animated preview of the bird rig
animal_bird_cap: A green bird of prey: the rig check sheet, the skin weights with the skeleton on top, and the animated preview.
animal_clip_lead: Nobody animates one model by hand. Each category keeps its own library of clips, and every new model of that category gets them by automatic retarget.
animal_clip1_d: For every category the engine generates reference videos of gaits and actions: walk, trot, canter, gallop, idle, rear, look around, attack and more. Each video is quality-checked before it is kept.
animal_clip2_d: The motion is extracted from the video once, so the clip can be reused for every model of the category.
animal_clip3_d: Each clip is retargeted onto the new rig automatically and measured by numeric QA. Procedural clips are only the fallback when a category has no clip yet.
animal_clip_custom: You can add your own clips in the viewer.
animal_conf_title: The skeleton is offered, never blocking
animal_conf_lead: The viewer shows the skeleton and offers it for confirmation. You do not have to answer: the animation is made without waiting for you.
animal_conf_b1: Press B for blueprint mode and move the bones, with symmetry.
animal_conf_b2: The model is re-rigged 15 seconds after your last edit, or at once with the button.
animal_conf_b3: Camera presets jump to the face, elbows, knees, feet and heels.
animal_view_title: Your animal in the Unity viewer
animal_view_lead: One task is one viewer. It opens on a black scene at once and plays the stages (voxels, erosion, bones, rig) while the mesh loads. Then it loads the environment scene.
animal_view_scene_a_alt: River glade, a viewer environment scene
animal_view_scene_b_alt: Jungle ruins, a viewer environment scene
animal_view_cap: Environment scenes with baked lighting, reflection and light probes and colliders: river glade, jungle ruins, cathedral, Sponza.
animal_view_b1: A session agent chat in every task: one shared agent for everyone who opens it, in the task creator's language.
animal_view_b2: Right mouse button pans, middle mouse button orbits, and every control shows its hotkey.
animal_view_b3: Download GLB, FBX, USDZ, a ZIP, a Unity package or a Blender file.
animal_q_lead: A stage that makes the rig right stays in the conveyor, even when it costs seconds.
animal_q1_d: Every retargeted clip is measured, not eyeballed.
animal_q2_d: Joint placement, skin tears, limb collisions and deformation are checked while the viewer is already open.
animal_q3_t: Every bad model becomes a test
animal_q3_d: A model that once rigged badly joins the regression suite, so the same defect cannot come back.
animal_q4_d: The engine goes live only after the regression autotests pass.

animal_faq_lead: Short answers for creators who rig animals and creatures.
animal_faq1_q: Which animals can AutoRig V3 rig?
animal_faq1_a: Quadrupeds (dogs, cats, bears, cows, pigs, rabbits, mice, elephants, giraffes, turtles), equines (horses, deer, zebras), birds, serpents, monsters and multilimb creatures such as spiders. Humanoids, hands, primates and cars have their own categories.
animal_faq2_q: Do I have to prepare a pose?
animal_faq2_a: No special preparation is needed. V3 works from the geometry. If the file already carries a skeleton or an animation, V3 uses the file's own bind pose instead of fitting a posed mesh.
animal_faq3_q: Can I start from a picture?
animal_faq3_a: Yes. A picture of an animal becomes a 3D model first, then it is rigged like any other model.
animal_faq4_q: Do I have to confirm the skeleton?
animal_faq4_a: No. The viewer offers the skeleton for confirmation, but the animation is made without waiting for it. You can open blueprint mode (B) at any time, move the bones and re-rig.
animal_faq5_a: The clips of the model's category, retargeted automatically: for example walk, trot and gallop for equines. They come from generated reference videos and are checked numerically. You can add custom clips in the viewer.
animal_faq6_q: What can I download, and do I need Blender?
animal_faq6_a: No Blender is needed: the service runs in the browser. Downloads: GLB, FBX, USDZ, a ZIP, a Unity package and a Blender file. A separate Blender plugin exists for a Blender-native workflow.
animal_end_text: Drop a 3D model or a picture of an animal on the home page. The target is a rigged, animated model within one minute from pickup.
